name: green-tests
prompt:
Work toward this goal: the full test suite passes

The success criterion is mechanical: `npm test` exits 0. Nothing else counts as done.

Each session: read tasks/todo.md and tasks/lessons.md first, then make the SMALLEST
verifiable increment toward the goal, run `npm test` yourself, and update
tasks/todo.md with what you did and what remains. Surgical changes only; follow AGENTS.md.
If you discover a rule the hard way, append it to tasks/lessons.md.

You have no memory of previous sessions — the tasks/ files are your memory. Trust them.
